# PsyTests.org

> A comprehensive repository of 4000+ free anonymous psychological tests and professional diagnostic methodologies for personality assessment, self-discovery, and mental health evaluation.

PsyTests.org provides access to both entertainment-oriented personality tests (MBTI, Big Five, Kokology) and clinical diagnostic instruments developed by renowned psychologists. The platform supports anonymous testing and personal account registration for tracking results.

## Key Topics

- MBTI
- Big Five (Большая пятерка)
- Kokology
- Psychodiagnostics
- Personality Assessment
- Hans Eysenck
- Victor Boyko
- Psychological Traits
- Mental Health
- Self-Discovery
- Relationship Tests
- Professional Methodologies
- Anonymous Testing
- Free Assessment
- Self-Testing

## Main Navigation

- [Homepage](https://psytests.org): Homepage offering free anonymous psychological tests and diagnostics

## Test Collections & Browsing

- [Psychological Tests by Theme](https://psytests.org/funtags.html): Thematic guide to personality tests including Big Five, MBTI, Kokology
- [Test Series by Author](https://psytests.org/funset.html): Test collections by Eysenck, Boyko, Ziverti and other psychologists
- [Popular Tests & Topics](https://psytests.org/map.html): Quick navigation to popular tests including MBTI and Rorschach
- [New & Featured Tests](https://psytests.org/newtop.html): Popular and important new tests on personality and psychology

## Reference & Search

- [Thematic Index of Methodologies](https://psytests.org/tags.html): Thematic index of 2000+ professional diagnostic and clinical tests
